reaction: The fallback of material helps clarify why Earth survives the impact.
reason: The only offered combination addresses the remaining goal of gathering rock into orbit.

reaction: The alternative formation route adds a useful qualification to the scenario.

mostWorthwhile.text: The giant impact was the strongest moment: it connected the collision to both a surviving, remelted Earth and outward-thrown debris.

leastWorthwhile.text: Setting up Theia’s path and angle felt a little procedural, with only one combination offered at each step.

surprise.text: Some simulations form a large satellite more directly rather than through the disk-accretion route followed here.

arbitrary.text: Preparing an angled impactor felt somewhat like a staging step, though the explanation made the geometry’s purpose clear.

continue.text: Yes. I’d be curious to see how the orbiting debris becomes the Moon, especially given the uncertainty about the route.
